CustomField.description: Formula field use to concatenate the Start Date and End Date so that we can use the field on the Right Rail Related List
CustomField.formula: TEXT(MONTH( Start_Date__c )) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Start_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Start_Date__c)) & " to " & TEXT(MONTH(End_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(End_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(End_Date__c))
CustomField.label: Dates
